title: Yad2 for-sale listings, Ra'anana / Раанана
source_kind: Yad2 search feed embedded __NEXT_DATA__ (asking prices, not closed deals)
photo_source_note: All photo URLs present in the search-feed JSON (metaData.images / cover). The feed provided at most 4 images per listing. Item pages were not re-crawled (Radware/hCaptcha already appeared once on page 3 of the search).
sorrento_note: דירה בהנחה / Sorrento, lottery 2607, ₪23,549/m² incl. VAT. Not a listing in this file. Nominatim returned 0 hits, so there is no map point.
ppm_formula: price_per_sqm = price / sqm_used; sqm_used prefers squareMeterBuild, else squareMeter. Computed 2026-11-23 from asking prices.
boundaries_note: Neighborhood polygons are approximate Voronoi cells (OSM place node or listing centroid as seed), clipped to municipal relation 1383630. OSM has neighbourhood/suburb nodes but no neighborhood boundary polygons.
captcha: Radware/hCaptcha appeared once when opening page 3; solved on the first attempt, then pages 4-8 loaded without another challenge.
encoding: CSV is UTF-8 with BOM (utf-8-sig). JSON is UTF-8. Arrays in CSV are joined with ' | '.
amenity_note: Amenity flags were derived only from Yad2 search-feed tags (and property type דירת גן for garden). The saved feed did not include structured fields for elevator (מעלית), storage (מחסן), air-con (מיזוג), or property condition; those flags are false unless a tag was present (none were, in this sample). Absence of a tag is not proof the amenity is missing from the apartment.
